extracted.intended_audience: Signing Officials/Authorized Organizational Representatives, PD/PIs, and applicant organization staff using ASSIST to submit NIH grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance for preparing and electronically submitting single- and multi-project NIH grant applications using the ASSIST system, including required statuses, validations, and credential requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application must be Ready for Submission to submit
rubrics_metrics.description: In order for an application to be submitted, the application status must be Ready for Submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Submit Application button is only enabled when the application is in Ready for Submission status. An application can only be updated to Ready for Submission status when it has passed all system and business validations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pass all system and business validations before Ready for Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: An application can only be updated to Ready for Submission status when it has passed all system and business validations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Validate Application button from the Actions section to perform validations; correct errors that prevent status update. ASSIST performs validations when updating status; for single-project applications this happens automatically when Update Submission Status is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two business day application viewing window after submission
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting, you have a 2 business day application viewing window to check your assembled application and Refer to Revise a Submitted Application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Your application automatically moves forward to the receipt and referral staff for further processing after the application viewing window has elapsed unless you explicitly 'reject' the application in eRA Commons Status module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative supplement viewing-window exception
rubrics_metrics.description: If you submitted an administrative supplement, a signing official can skip the two day viewing window by clicking the Verify link in the Status module for the supplement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the related topic in eRA Commons help for details about skipping the viewing window for supplements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-project: component finalization requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify that at least one component of the application is in Final status and that the other components are in either Final or Abandoned status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also verify that the status of the application is All Components Final before proceeding with validations and submission steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-project: validate to reach All Components Validated
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform validations against the application using the Validate Application button from the Actions section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an application passes validations, its status is updated to All Components Validated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update submission status to Ready for Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Update the application to Ready for Submission using the Update Submission Status button from the Actions section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This step is required prior to selecting Submit Application; ASSIST may perform validations when updating status (noted explicitly for single-project submissions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Only a Signing Official (Authorized Organizational Representative) may submit
rubrics_metrics.description: Only a Signing Official for the Applicant Lead Organization, who is an Authorized Organizational Representative, can submit the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The person who clicks Submit Application must be the AOR/SO for the applicant lead organization; ordinary users cannot complete the Grants.gov submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit Application action enabled only in Ready for Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: With the application in Ready for Submission status, select the Submit Application button from the Application Information screen. The button is located next to the Status field and is only enabled when the application is in Ready for Submission status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For single-project applications the Submit Application button is available from the Actions area once Ready for Submission status is set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enter Grants.gov AOR credentials to submit
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST prompts the user for the Grants.gov Authorized Organization Representative (AOR) credentials. Enter the AOR credentials in the Username and Password fields and select the Enter button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOTE: These are the Grants.gov credentials and not the ASSIST or eRA Commons credentials. The information is passed from ASSIST to the Grants.gov system for further processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission status, timestamps, and notifications recorded
rubrics_metrics.description: In ASSIST, the application is updated to a status of Submitted. The dates and times of the submission are recorded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These details can be viewed in the View Status History page. In addition, ASSIST sends notification to the appropriate parties to inform them that the application has been submitted. This includes the SO and PD/PI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-project: optional validation before updating status
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional: Perform validations against the application using the Validate Application button from the Actions section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may perform this validation step manually before updating submission status, though ASSIST will also perform validations when status is updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-project: optional comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional: Provide a comment if desired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an optional step when preparing a single-project application for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Errors must be corrected; warnings may be submitted but should be reviewed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the application fails validation, any errors and warnings are listed on the Application Errors and Warnings Results page, which opens as a separate window. Errors must be corrected before submitting the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although you may submit your application with existing Warnings, please make sure to review all warnings and correct the necessary items.
